dispositions.preserve: Keep current recipes' original status as implementer designs and prior bounded use; public corroboration is later evidence, not original authorship.
dispositions.recommend: Transfer specific mechanisms and real cases, then compare later matching work against an appropriate baseline.
dispositions.not_adopted: Source-specific approval gates, quotas, mandatory tools, installations, terminology restrictions, universal business metrics or claimed universal timing/accuracy thresholds.

stopping_basis: Primary mechanisms, actual revision/incident examples, fit and conflicts, and evaluation gaps are sufficient to answer the research request. The next important uncertainty needs target-task observations and authorized history rather than more prompt catalogs.

verification.scope: Repository artifact integrity only; not an effectiveness test of the researched methods.
